summary.text: Greg Stemen is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 27 since December 1, 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Stemen received his undergraduate education from Valley City State University and his master's degree from Southwest Minnesota State University, according to Ballotpedia.
He was appointed to the House on December 1, 2020, to fill the vacancy created by the election of Thomas Beadle as state treasurer.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignment as vice chair of the Appropriations - Human Resources Division Committee.
